name: onhundred-protocol-log
author: Ale Sánchez (https://onhundred.com)
description: Your own Onhundred Protocol log: an MCP server for your agents, a private grid page and a D1 database, on your Cloudflare account.

OWNER_PASSWORD.description: The password you type to sign in to your log and to allow AI apps like Claude and ChatGPT to connect. Choose a long one.

COOKIE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Signs your sign-in cookie. 32 characters or more. Generate one in a terminal with: openssl rand -hex 32

DB.description: Your log: loops, experiments, connections and the full history of changes.

BACKUPS.description: A JSON snapshot of the log, written every night, and the images of your share cards.

BROWSER.description: Browser Rendering: takes the pictures of your share cards in the background. Without it, shared links use the default preview.

OAUTH_KV.description: Sign-in grants for the AI apps you connect.

WRITER.description: Applies every change one at a time, so two agents can never break a rule together.

PUBLISH.description: "true" makes your grid and /public.json visible to everyone. Leave "false" to keep the log private.

LANGUAGES.description: Languages of your loop names and questions, comma-separated. For example: en or en,es.
